protocol.scope: Newly partitioned internal chemical-family benchmark with fresh supervised weights; not an external dataset
protocol.primary: Unperturbed test C2 MRR@25: fresh full model minus D1+D2 baseline
protocol.secondary: Joint paired bootstrap over all prespecified ablation/control contrasts and C1/C2/C3
protocol.test_policy: All rankers, feature lists and model hashes sealed before test feature generation. Test never used for training, stopping or hyperparameter selection.
protocol.retrieval_policy: The retrieval corpus may contain evaluation-family references according to the C1 task definition. Per-query C2/C3 exclude metric-equivalent truth references. Query-family disjointness concerns supervised fitting, not a reference-free discovery task.
protocol.promotion_policy: Report all outcomes, including failures and negative controls; no automatic model promotion or competition submission
protocol.budget: Existing free Kaggle execution only; no hosted inference, paid infrastructure or external LLM calls

fingerprint_training.initialization: fresh seeded random; no archived weights
fresh seeded random; no archived weights

source_manifest.method: streaming SHA-256 per local input file
source_manifest.source_assertion: local byte identity only; no independent Kaggle/BigQuery validation

candidate_source_quality.interpretation: Pre-aggregation identity consistency only; not RDKit verification

structure_quarantine.scope: Parseable, heavy-atom-containing, nonzero Morgan structures; not provider identity authentication

search_memo.scope: per-query full-cleaned-content plus exact exclusion set; no index file cache

primary.contrast: Unperturbed test C2 MRR@25: fresh full model minus D1+D2 baseline
primary.interpretation: Single predeclared paired diagnostic; no automatic promotion

secondary_joint_intervals.method: molecule-paired max-deviation bootstrap over all prespecified secondary contrasts
secondary_joint_intervals.limitations: Approximate fixed-family uncertainty; no correction for domain shift or historical hypothesis selection

limitations: Internal source data, not newly acquired external spectra or an independent laboratory replication.
Family-disjoint supervised query fitting does not remove the task-defined retrieval reference corpus.
Generic Murcko topology and acyclic connectivity are computational grouping rules, not a guarantee of distant chemistry.
Fixed training sample and small fresh fingerprint architecture trade capacity for auditable zero-cost execution; no state-of-the-art claim.
Feature ablations reuse a fixed generated candidate universe; no_gen_features does not remove candidate generation.
Slices are descriptive; subgroup intervals do not establish multiplicity-adjusted subgroup effects.
No raw spectra, structures, query identifiers, per-query ranks, model weights or submitted predictions are exported.
